name: Nacho's MR Inbox
summary: The GitLab project's open merge requests by what they need, its merge train, add-to-train and job retry, with CI Doctor for GitLab CI.

command: query=query($fullPath:ID!){currentUser{username} project(fullPath:$fullPath){fullPath webUrl mergeTrains{nodes{targetBranch cars(first:20){nodes{status mergeRequest{iid} pipeline{status jobs{count} done:jobs(statuses:[SUCCESS,FAILED,CANCELED,SKIPPED,MANUAL]){count} running:jobs(statuses:[RUNNING]){count}}}}}} mergeRequests(state:opened,first:50,sort:UPDATED_DESC){nodes{iid title webUrl draft updatedAt author{username avatarUrl} sourceBranch targetBranch diffHeadSha detailedMergeStatus conflicts approvalsLeft approvalsRequired reviewers{nodes{username mergeRequestInteraction{reviewState}}} resolvableDiscussionsCount resolvedDiscussionsCount headPipeline{id status sha jobs{count} done:jobs(statuses:[SUCCESS,FAILED,CANCELED,SKIPPED,MANUAL]){count} running:jobs(statuses:[RUNNING]){count}}}} merged:mergeRequests(state:merged,first:50,sort:MERGED_AT_DESC){nodes{iid title webUrl sourceBranch mergedAt author{username avatarUrl}}}}}
